## There are many benefits of using self-storage in Chennai while moving to a new area of Chennai. One of the reasons self-storages is beneficial for moving is because of the flexibility in scheduling. A lot of the time moves won't be scheduled together and as a result some rooms will get booked up. Using self-storage will give you the flexibility to move some rooms in extra time.


**[Self storage in Chennai](https://stownest.com/self-storage-chennai)** makes it easier to move from one neighborhood to another because you have a place to put your things while you wait for your new home to be ready and while your old lease allows your things to stay there. It minimizes having to move everything at once.


## **The Move That Doesn't Line Up Neatly**


Moving within Chennai, be it shifting from OMR to Sholinganallur or from T. Nagar to Velachery, happens across multiple days, rather than all on one single day. Lease agreements end on one day, and agreements on the other end begin on a different day. The gap stretches even further due to the turmoil of job changes, family relocation, and desiring a better neighborhood. As a result, "moving day" becomes a series of overlapping weekdays rather than one day.


Most people do not account for this gap.When this happens people inevitably end up dealing with the aftermath. That leads to people stuffing their things into a friend or family member's spare room, or leaving things behind them in their old apartments for a few days longer.


## **What Makes Relocating Within Chennai Specifically Tricky**


- **Lease overlap is rare** . There are often gaps between a lease ending and a new lease beginning which can leave gaps with furniture having nowhere to go.
- **Chennai’s traffic can affect the convenience of a move.** For instance, what seems like an easy move, like from Adyar to Porur, can end up being multiple trips when traffic and the lack of support for the move is considered.
- **Unexpected moves** . A frequently underestimated issue is a last minute move to a new place with a new design and layout. This can leave much space and time dedicated to your move, but end up being nothing.


Instead of trying to do too much to save time, what could be done in multiple trips can be done safely in multiple trips. This could avoid haphazardly placing things and causing damage.


## **How This Actually Slows People Down**


When there is no gap between moving out and moving in, people frequently have to pay for additional days at their previous residence to have a safe place for keeping their possessions. Many people also ask their friends and family to hold onto their boxes and they also have to deal with the stress of not knowing where the boxes are. Everyone should have the choice to start a new and fresh chapter in life, and this problem should not exist **.**


## **How Self Storage Solves the Actual Problem**


This is the perfect solution for the gap self storage was designed for. Instead of having to line up the dates of your old house and your new house, your belongings get put into storage to fill that gap, whether it be a few days or a few weeks or anywhere in between. There's no need to rush to finish everything in one day, and you don't even have to bother someone to store your stuff for you.


It gets even better with self storage pickup and delivery. Instead of having to do multiple trips yourself to store your stuff, they do it for you. It keeps track of everything, so you don't lose any of your stuff and it makes multiple trips. When your new house is ready for you, you simply contact them to deliver it, no scramble required.


## **Who This Helps Most**


This tends to affect certain kinds of internal moves within Chennai the most, including people whose lease begins after their current one ends, families moving to a smaller home to decide what they want to keep, and anyone without a large enough vehicle or moving crew who has to make several trips to move everything.


## **A Smoother Move Doesn't Require Perfect Timing**


You don’t have to worry about timing when moving within Chennai. Using self storage relieves the pressure around timing for moving your stuff. While you finish one home and begin another, your stuff can be stored in a safe place for as long as you need it instead of rushing to do it all in one stressful day.


## **Key Takeaways**


-


Many relocations within Chennai mean that people have to deal with the gap between lease dates.


-


Moves in most other cities can be done in one trip. But even the shorter moves in Chennai can be very time consuming.


-


People end up losing belongings because they have to store their things with friends or family. Self storage fills the gap in the process.


-


Hassles of moving logistics are completely eliminated if one immigrates with pickup-and-delivery storage.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. How is self storage in Chennai important for relocation?**


First of all, self storage in Chennai creates the opportunity to store your belongings to avoid the stress of having to move to your new home in a span of a day.


**2. Does self storage help if you just move within Chennai, let’s say from OMR to Sholinganallur?**


Yes, self storage would be particularly helpful if the lease for your old home and the new home do not line up or the new home is not yet ready for you to move into.


**3. Is it necessary for you to have your own vehicle for transporting your belongings for storage?**


No, with a **[pickup-and-delivery service](https://stownest.com/packers-movers-chennai)** your items will be transported directly to your new home once your old home is vacated.


**4. For how long am I allowed to store my belongings during the relocation process?**
